1.text: Ibisigaye bene Data, mudusabire kugira ngo ijambo ry'Umwami wacu ryamamare vuba rishimishwe nk'uko biri muri mwe,

2.text: kandi ngo dukire abantu babi b'ibigoryi kuko kwizera kudafitwe na bose.

3.text: Ariko Umwami ni uwo kwizerwa, ni we uzakomeza mwebwe, abarinde Umubi.

4.text: Kandi ibyanyu tubyiringijwe n'Umwami, yuko ibyo dutegetse mubikora kandi muzajya mubikora.

5.text: Umwami ayobore imitima yanyu, ayerekeze ku rukundo rw'Imana no ku kwihangana kwa Kristo.

6.text: Nuko bene Data, turabategeka mu izina ry'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo kuzibukīra mwene Data wese ugenda yica gahunda, cyangwa udakurikiza ibibabwiriza mwahawe natwe.

7.text: Ubwanyu muzi uko mukwiriye kutwigana kuko tuticaga gahunda muri mwe,

8.text: cyangwa ngo tugire uwo turya iby'ubusa, ahubwo twagiraga umuhati n'imiruho dukora ku manywa na nijoro, kugira ngo tutagira umuntu muri mwe turemerera.

9.text: Icyakora si uko tudafite ubutware, ahubwo ni ukugira ngo tubiheho icyitegerezo ngo mugere ikirenge mu cyacu,

10.text: kuko iki ari cyo twabategetse tukiri kumwe namwe, ngo umuntu wese wanga gukora ntakarye.

11.text: Twumvise yuko hariho bamwe bo muri mwe bagenda bica gahunda, batagira icyo bakora ahubwo bakaba ba kazitereyemo.

12.text: Nuko rero abameze batyo turabategeka tubihanangiririza mu Mwami Yesu Kristo, gukorana ituza ngo babone uko barya ibyokurya byabo ubwabo.

13.text: Ariko mwebweho bene Data, ntimugacogorere gukora neza.

14.text: Kandi nihagira umuntu utumvira ijambo ryacu ryo muri uru rwandiko, mumenye mumuhe akato kugira ngo akorwe n'isoni.

15.text: Ariko ntimumutekereze ko ari umwanzi wanyu, ahubwo mumuhugure nka mwene So.

16.text: Nuko rero Umwami wacu w'amahoro ajye abaha amahoro iteka ryose mu buryo bwose. Umwami abane namwe mwese.

17.text: Uku ni ko gutashya kwanjye Pawulo kwanditswe n'ukwanjye kuboko, ni cyo kimenyetso mu nzandiko zanjye zose, ni ko nandika.

18.text: Ubuntu bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo bubane namwe mwese.
